body: ChatGPT Images lets you create new images and edit existing images directly inside ChatGPT. Turn plain-language prompts into original images, explore different visual directions. In this video, learn three ways to get started: creating an image from scratch, refining its look through conversation, and editing a photo you already have. Along the way, see how the details you share help guide the result. Ready to try it? Open a chat to create something new or give an existing photo a different look: https://chatgpt.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=CNT-chatgpt-images-three-ways-to-get-started&utm_content=description_try_chatgpt Looking for inspiration? Explore templates and trending images: https://chatgpt.com/images?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=CNT-chatgpt-images-three-ways-to-get-started&utm_content=description_explore_images
